name: STORIUM
description: STORIUM is a dataset and evaluation platform for machine-in-the-loop story generation, built from the Storium online collaborative storytelling community. It contains 6,000 lengthy stories (125M tokens) with fine-grained natural language annotations including character goals and attributes interspersed throughout each narrative.
reputation: Published at EMNLP 2020; notable for integrating real human authors into the evaluation loop
notes: Evaluation involves real authors on the Storium platform querying models for story continuations and editing them; automatic metrics over edits correlate with user ratings; large output space makes evaluation challenging.
